answer: Since disagreement costs everyone the epoch, the tide audit records every split and the operator cannot buy agreement cheaply. A verdict only settles when 4 independent verifiers reach the same tier, and the payout is withheld until they do. That is 16 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
